args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

Note from Sofia on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Same Mid-Atlantic home goods account.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living. The older label is making the supervisor search twice.
- "PHL" also belongs to Pellucid Harbor Logistics, a separate Gulf Coast terminal account. Check the org ID before any bulk seat audit or bulk action.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Could you update the saved report label, and help disambiguate the "PHL" shorthand in the shared views?

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (via Bettina Kroll)
